messages.subject: Falcon - diligence findings so far
messages.plaintextBody:
Two items emerging from the data room worth flagging early:
1. Pawsome Retail Group supply agreement (~12% of revenue) has a change-of-control termination right - we'll want this as a condition.
2. Brookfield Mill lease needs landlord consent to the change of control.
Both go on the conditions list. Also a small ET claim from a former employee, low value. I'll fold these into the DD report.

James

--
